name: Finding A Mate
overview: Scripture reveals that God designed companionship as essential for man, creating a suitable helper to meet his need for relational unity, as seen in Genesis 2:18. The sacred bond of marriage is established when a man leaves his parents and unites with his wife, becoming one flesh (Genesis 2:24). Finding a spouse is portrayed as a blessing and favor from the Lord (Proverbs 18:22), and believers are encouraged to seek God's guidance through prayer, trusting that He knows their needs and will provide accordingly (Matthew 6:32; 7:7). The seriousness of marriage is underscored by Jesus' teaching on its permanence and the conditions for its dissolution (Matthew 19:3).
